facts.statement: The platform should minimise personal data collected on projects/users, conduct a data protection impact assessment before adding features that process new categories of personal data, and maintain records of processing activity (GDPR/CCPA).
Project and user data must be encrypted both at rest and in transit.

Uploaded files must be validated server-side with a format-specific parser (not by file extension or client-supplied Content-Type alone), renamed on the server, and never served directly from a user-writable path.
facts.source_title: File Upload - OWASP Cheat Sheet Series

facts.statement: Every uploaded file must be scanned for malicious content before it is made accessible to other users.
Third-party integrations (e.g. Git hosting) must authenticate via OAuth 2.0 Authorization Code flow with PKCE and a CSRF-protecting state parameter; production redirect URIs must use HTTPS.
The web application should conform to WCAG 2.2 Level AA.
facts.source_title: WCAG 2.2 Accessibility Standards: Complete 2026 Compliance Guide

facts.statement: The system must maintain an immutable audit log of user actions (task changes, permission changes, file access) for compliance review and security investigation.
facts.source_title: Enterprise Ready SaaS App Guide to Audit Logging

facts.statement: A data retention policy should ensure data is not kept longer than necessary for the purpose it was collected for.
facts.source_title: The Ultimate Guide to Data Compliance in 2026
